protocol: The development sample was labelled BEFORE any classifier code was written, to avoid anchoring on machine output.
TOPIC_VOCAB_FRACTION and MIN_REFERENTS were then tuned against the development labels only.
The held-out sample was labelled AFTER those two constants were frozen, without inspecting predictions.

criterion: contentless = after stripping first-person/contribution framing, evaluative and comparative rhetoric, the manuscript's own protagonist artifact names, intra-document deixis, and generic academic prose, the claim names no external entity and no specific domain phenomenon -- only its own topic label. Such a claim cannot discriminate among its manuscript's candidate references, so no retriever can serve it. An inline citation marker always makes a claim servable.
